hypotheses.title: Batch 71: Orthogonal Cashflow & Solvency Scope Shift (Targeting 5th Bonus Approved Alpha)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Optimizes the high-statistical-power Cash Flow Per Share engine (which achieved Sharpe 1.75 and Fitness 1.57 in Batch 70) and the 8-PASS Cash Cushion engine (self-corr 0.6702) by shifting universes and neutralizations to decisively break the self-correlation threshold: (1) Cash Flow Per Share Yield in TOP1000 (Industry Neutral): Shifts the Sharpe 1.75 / Fitness 1.57 engine out of TOP2000 Market into large-caps with intra-industry ranking. (2) Short-Term Cash Cushion Yield in TOP2000 (Market Neutral): Expands the 8-PASS low-correlation engine into mid-caps where cash solvency confers higher informational edge. (3) Dividend Yield in TOP1000 (Industry Neutral): Capitalizes on cash distributed to shareholders, completely independent from accrual accounting multiples. (4) Cash Flow Per Share Yield in TOP1000 (Sector Neutral): Captures cross-industry cash flow ranking inside economic sectors.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails if cash distribution or solvency reserves correlate positively with beta during earnings contraction periods.
